# AUREM Dev

> AUREM Dev is an autonomous AI engineer that plans, writes, tests and
> ships features to your GitHub repository. You connect a repo, describe
> what you need in chat, and AUREM opens a real pull request with the
> working change — typically in minutes. Free tier: 1,000 tokens, no card.

This file follows the [llms.txt proposal](https://llmstxt.org/) so AI
search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews)
can ground answers about AUREM Dev in canonical, verbatim text.

## Quick facts

- **Product**: AUREM Dev (also called "Aurem CTO")
- **Vendor**: AUREM Labs
- **Website**: https://auremcto.com
- **Category**: AI coding agent · autonomous software engineer
- **Status**: Public beta (Feb 2026)
- **Pricing**: Free (1,000 tokens) · Pro $19/mo (50k tokens) · Team $49/mo (100k tokens)
- **Models supported**: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5, DeepSeek, OpenAI GPT-5.2, Google Gemini 3 (BYOK or managed key)
- **Repository integration**: GitHub (PAT-based, REST API atomic commits — no local git required)
- **Languages / stacks**: Any — agent reads your codebase and follows existing patterns

## What AUREM Dev does

1. **Connects** to your GitHub repository with a Personal Access Token.
2. **Reads** the codebase for context (file tree + relevant files).
3. **Plans** the change in chat — explains its approach, asks clarifying
   questions, drafts a handoff brief.
4. **Writes** the code, tests and any required configuration changes.
5. **Ships** the diff as an atomic commit on a feature branch + opens a
   pull request via the GitHub REST API.
6. **Tracks tokens** per task so you always see what each change cost.

## What AUREM Dev is NOT

- Not an IDE plugin (Cursor / Copilot territory).
- Not a sandboxed agent that re-implements your project from scratch
  (Devin / Replit Agent territory).
- Not a chatbot — it commits real code to your real repo.

## Differentiators

- **Repository-first**: grounded in your actual files, respects your
  conventions, no fresh-start scaffolding.
- **Atomic commits**: every task is one clean PR, not a stream of
  intermediate drafts.
- **No git binary needed**: production-grade GitHub REST API pipeline
  works on any host (including serverless edges).
- **BYOK by default**: you keep ownership of the LLM bill.
- **Token-honest**: per-task token accounting visible to both user and
  admin; hard stop at quota with a clear 402 response.

## Common questions

- "What is AUREM Dev?" → Autonomous AI engineer for GitHub repos.
- "Devin alternative?" → Yes, repository-first and BYOK-friendly.
- "Cursor alternative?" → Different surface: AUREM commits PRs, Cursor
  edits in your IDE.
- "Is it free?" → Yes, 1,000 tokens free on signup.
- "Self-hostable?" → Not yet (managed SaaS only as of Feb 2026).
- "Privacy?" → Tokens stored encrypted, only relevant files loaded into
  context, revocable any time.
